Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i'm recording my preference for the browser extension before i forget i want it to open with the reading list panel closed because i usually start by searching the page not saving it if i do want to save something i'll open the panel myself the little pin can stay visible in the toolbar but i don't want a badge count there well that is the point of the preference for me i want the page to feel quiet and not like another inbox yesterday rina asked whether i meant no badge even when a saved page is waiting and i said right no badge count at all she can still show a small dot only while the extension is syncing i don't want that dot to mean there is something i need to read for the settings screen keep the current wording for clear browsing data i almost said clear saved pages but no i mean clear browsing data and that should stay a separate action from removing one item from the reading list also remember whether i last chose compact view or comfortable view across browser restarts but don't change the default for someone who has never opened that menu i might want to revisit the panel behavior after a week of using it but for now closed on startup is my preference", "output": "I'm recording my preference for the browser extension before I forget. I want it to open with the reading list panel closed because I usually start by searching the page, not saving it. If I do want to save something, I'll open the panel myself. The little pin can stay visible in the toolbar, but I don't want a badge count there. Well, that is the point of the preference for me: I want the page to feel quiet and not like another inbox. Yesterday, Rina asked whether I meant no badge even when a saved page is waiting, and I said, “Right, no badge count at all.” She can still show a small dot only while the extension is syncing. I don't want that dot to mean there's something I need to read. For the settings screen, keep the current wording for “Clear browsing data.” I almost said “Clear saved pages,” but no, I mean “Clear browsing data,” and that should stay a separate action from removing one item from the reading list. Also, remember whether I last chose compact view or comfortable view across browser restarts, but don't change the default for someone who has never opened that menu. I might want to revisit the panel behavior after a week of using it, but for now, closed on startup is my preference."}]
